sman mchod ni/ston pa kun bzang rgyal tshab rigs lnga mchog/dga' rab la sogs brda brgyud rig 'dzin rnams/ /grags chen gsal ba'i ston pa bcu gnyis la/ /

tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250sman mchod ni/ 1$0000300ston pa kun bzang rgyal tshab rigs lnga mchog /dga' rab la sogs brda brgyud rig 'dzin rnams// grags chen gsal ba'i ston pa bcu gnyis la// sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsol// sarba pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi/ rigs gsum sems dpa' lung bstan rdo rje dang*// u pa rā dza 'byor pa'i dbang po sogs// ro langs bde ba rdo rje bzhad rtsal la// sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsol// sarba pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi/ dam pa'i rigs can lnga dang rgyal po dza// ku ku rā dza in+d+ra bhū ti sogs// sgeg rdor sangs rgyas gsang ba bi ma lar// sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsol// sarba pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi/ rnam gsum yo ga'i bdag po o rgyan rje// rgyal yum mtsho rgyal lo chen bai ro'i zhabs// gter chen bla ma rgyal sras rnam gnyis la// sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsol// sarba pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi/ chos dbyings rang grol za hor sngags smyon mchog /badz+ra k+ṣa ra kun bzang pad+ma dbang*// gu ru 'od zer nam mkha'i rnal 'byor la// sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsol// sarba pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi/ brgyud pa bdun ldan klong chen rab 'byams dang*// dbyer med mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer 'jigs med gling*// brgyud pa kun 'dus kun bzang gzhan phan la// sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsol// sarba pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi/ kun tu bzang po thod phreng yab yum dang*// rtsa gsum 'dus pa rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro zhing skyong gzhi bdag la// sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsol// sarba pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/

rjes 'brel du dngos grub blang ba ni/ bdud rtsi snying po can gyi dbus// sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs// yi ge gsum gyi rnam pa can// dam tshig phyag rgya gnyan pos blang*// kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ wā ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ sarba sid+dhi hrīḥ
